description: v3 only, Ethereum only. Build an unsigned transaction that moves a wallet's stkGHO out of the Safety Module and into the sGHO vault. All-or-nothing: it covers the entire stkGHO position and takes no amount. Call get_safety_module with the same wallet first and quote the legacy stkGHO balance it returns, so the user knows what they are moving before they sign. Non-custodial, so build it rather than asking permission first.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v3': this tool exists on v3 only.

title: Prepare a stkGHO migration into sGHO
